title: Jack
raw_text:
INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

JACK stands at the edge of a raised platform. Behind him, a row of shipping containers hums under sodium lights.

JACK
You weren't supposed to come alone.

MARA (O.S.)
And yet, here I am.

JACK
Then let's finish it. No more messages. No more couriers. Just us and whatever we decide is left.

MARA
You say that like you already know the ending.

JACK
I know how it looks when a man runs out of moves. I've been him. I've watched him.

MARA (CONT'D)
And yet you keep asking for another round.

JACK
Because quitting is louder than losing.

MARA
Quiet has its uses, Jack.

JACK
Not tonight.

MARA (softer)
Always tonight.

JACK
Give me one reason to walk away.

MARA
One? I brought three. Take your pick.

JACK
Name them.

MARA
You already know.

JACK
Say them.

MARA
Your sister. Your promise. Your name.

JACK
Those aren't reasons. Those are hooks.

MARA
Call them what you want. They still hold.

JACK
Then cut me loose.

MARA
I came here to try.

JACK
Then try harder.
